_doc: Layouts of places (v0.8.0, LayoutGen, LayoutRules): a square is 5 ft. `cells` — what a character of a chunk means; `open.gap` / `open.room_gap` — squares a new way keeps from the ways already there on an open map and in a building's room (v0.8.4.36), `open.road_cost` — what a square costs a road, a character that is not there stops it; `kinds` — a place's kind by the tag of its site: its shape (building, tunnels, open), family, rooms with roles and their limit, the size and scatter of an open map; `chunks` — parts of maps: `rows` of `cells`, D — a door socket on the edge, letters of `marks` — named floor squares, a blank — leave the map as it is (landmarks), and outside a chunk's own walls (a cave's ragged hall), drawn as rock in tunnels (`grounds.cells`). Rotations and mirrors make new variants of a chunk. The chain of picking a chunk: kind and role, family and role, the room's tags, a generic chunk of the size.

f.name: fence
f._doc: v0.8.4.43.44: a wattle fence round a yard or a garden: not walked, seen over; its picture joins its neighbours (grounds.turn `line`)

$.name: deep water
$._doc: v0.8.4.43.44: the deep middle of a pond, every square round it of the pond (LayoutGen._deep): swum, not waded

_.name: bridge
_._doc: v0.8.4.43.36: a bridge over water: walked, its deck a ground (planks) whose edge with the water is drawn; laid where a road crosses water (open.bridges)

|.name: waterfall
|._doc: v0.8.4.43.36: water falling over a cliff: not walked, seen over; a cliff square with water on two opposite sides (open.falls)

&.name: lava
&._doc: v0.8.4.43.32: molten rock: not walked, seen over; in a fight a square with no floor as a pit (FightGrid.PIT), one who falls or is shoved in burns by rules.combat.grid.lava

:.name: high
:._doc: high ground: a floor raised over the lowland, walked onto where it meets the lowland with no cliff

/.name: cliff
/._doc: a steep slope round high ground: not walked, seen over

grounds._doc: What a map is drawn of (LayoutGen.grounds, MapField's dual grid): the ground of a square by its character of `cells` — a string for any place, a dictionary by the place's kind, the kinds of its family, its shape (`open`, `building`, `tunnels`) — the most exact key first — with `*` for the rest (LayoutGen.ground_keys), a character not here takes the one of `.`; `order` — the grounds from the lowest layer to the highest: at a meeting of grounds the higher one lies over; `sharp` — a ground whose edge stays on the square's border (walls), the others meet by a rough line between the squares' centres; `patches` — by the same keys (the first that has rows; an empty list — none), patches of another ground over the floor's own ground: `share` of the floor in blobs of about `cell` squares by the map's seed, or `near` — a rim of `width` squares round the squares of that character (a beach); `props` — a thing drawn on the square by the character and the same keys; `repeat` — squares one texture spans; `colour` — a ground with no texture yet; `edges` — pairs of grounds whose meeting is drawn (a sheet of the 16 dual-grid tiles, assets/tiles/edges/<low>__<high>.png, its alpha the line between them), the rest meet by the mask; `edge_layout` — the 5×5 corners the sheet is laid on (1 — the higher ground), its sixteen 2×2 windows each case once; `edge_band` — how wide the drawn edge lies on both sides of the line. Textures: assets/tiles/ground/<id>.png, things: assets/tiles/props/<id>.png (tools/tiles/gen_tiles.py).

thin._doc: v0.8.4.43.49, the author: «скамья вдвое уже стола, а то по ней не понять, что можно ходить»: the share of its short side a thing's picture takes on its squares (map_ground.gdshader `prop_thin`)

same._doc: v0.8.4.43.28: a ground drawn with the texture of another — the rim of high ground over a cliff is its top's grass, its own id gives the cliff's drawn edge with the lowland

turn._doc: v0.8.4.43.36: how a thing of a square turns (LayoutGen.prop_turn): `walls` — across a wall with walls on both sides (a door), `fall` — down from the high ground (a waterfall, its picture falls top to bottom)

blend._doc: v0.8.4.43.41: no repeat of a ground every few squares — its texture read twice, as it is and mirrored and shifted, mixed by a noise of `scale` per square with a border `edge` wide; its tone lighter or darker by `macro` in patches of `macro_scale` (map_ground.gdshader `ground`)

exits._doc: v0.8.4.43.40: the thing drawn on the square of a way out by its kind — `edge` the rim of an open map, `stairs` a way down to another floor, `stairs_up` a way up; a door is its own `+`. Turned so its top looks out of the map or to the wall the stairs stand by (LayoutGen.props_laid with the map's exits)

variants._doc: v0.8.4.43.37: a thing drawn in more pictures than one: `<id>`, `<id>_v1`, `<id>_v2`… — each square takes one by its number (LayoutGen.variant, by the map's seed), so a grove is not one tree copied

natural._doc: v0.8.4.43.37: things that grow or lie as nature put them: each square sizes and shifts its picture a little by its number (`scale`, `shift` of a square), and a soft shade lies on the ground round them, merged with the shade of those beside

groups._doc: v0.8.4.43.37: like things side by side drawn as one picture (LayoutGen.props_laid): the largest that fits first, row by row; a group of two stands either way. The squares keep their own rules: only the look is one

strips._doc: v0.8.4.43.36: a thing drawn as a strip of one FLUX frame (gen_tiles.py `strips`): a square takes its part by its like neighbours across its fall (LayoutGen.prop_at) — alone, the left end, the middle, the right end; the picture of each is `<thing>_<part>`

shimmer._doc: v0.8.4.43.36: a thing whose picture moves in the shader along its own top to bottom (falling water): how strong

motion._doc: v0.8.4.43.32: a ground that moves in the shader: `flow` — how its picture drifts, squares a second; `waver` — how it ripples; `glow` — how it flickers and shines through the dark (lava). A ground not here stands still.

edges._doc: v0.8.4.43.36: the deck of a bridge over the water

bridges._doc: v0.8.4.43.36: a road laid over a liquid square lays a bridge there: the liquid → the bridge cell

deep._doc: v0.8.4.43.44: the middle of a pond whose every square round is of the pond becomes its deep water: the liquid → the deep cell (LayoutGen._deep, after the roads and the bridges); a lone deep square goes back

falls._doc: v0.8.4.43.36: a cliff square with the same liquid on two opposite sides becomes its fall: the liquid → the fall cell

ponds._doc: v0.8.4.43.32: a tag of a place → the cell of a pond of its open map (not a map of open chunks: a pond of water comes with its pieces)

terrains._doc: v0.8.4.31, the author's feedback (the master's open places were empty fields): an open room whose site names no kind takes one by its location's terrain, else `default`.

spots._doc: Spots of things (v0.8.4.43.26): a mark `spot:<group>` of a chunk is a square where a thing of the group may stand: the master puts the furniture of its words there, a body of the spot's group (`bodies` by the place's kind, its family, its shape, `*`). v0.8.4.43.51 (the author: «брать фиксированную расстановку полностью»): the room's own things are one furnishing of its chunk (`furnish`, whole), nothing stands on a spot by chance; the spots no thing of it stands on are the master's.

chunks._doc: v0.8.4.43.49, the author: «на рыночной площади самим разместить, где какие предметы могут стоять»: each stall its whole 2×2 square of marks, the goods behind the stalls set by hand as furnishings — a group of things side by side stands whole or not at all (MapSpots._clusters).

furnish.name: Товар за прилавками и у рядов
